description: This file defines the DataGroupPermission class in PHP, representing permissions associated with user roles for data groups in an HRM system. It includes properties for different permissions (read, create, update, delete, self) and provides methods to instantiate from an array and access individual permissions.

classes.name: DataGroupPermission
classes.description: A class that encapsulates permissions for a user role within a data group, including methods for creation from an array and permission checks.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the DataGroupPermission object with specified permissions for a user role.

methods.name: createFromArray
methods.description: Creates an instance of DataGroupPermission from an associative array defining the role and permissions.

methods.name: getUserRole
methods.description: Returns the user role associated with this permission set.

methods.name: canRead
methods.description: Checks if the read permission is granted.

methods.name: canCreate
methods.description: Checks if the create permission is granted.

methods.name: canUpdate
methods.description: Checks if the update permission is granted.

methods.name: canDelete
methods.description: Checks if the delete permission is granted.

methods.name: isSelf
methods.description: Checks if the self permission is granted.
